sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
RIGHT did nothing (diff 0). So the arrow keys don't move the red piece. Then what does the arrow do? Previously, the arrow was moving the green player. Wait — is the green player still at (40-41, 12-13)? Let me check. In the current image, the green player appears to be at the bottom-right of the gray block. If RIGHT did nothing, maybe the green player is clamped... no, it was at (40-41, 12-13), which is the rightmost column (block cols 8-13, player width 2 → max col 12). So RIGHT at the right edge = clamped, no movement! That explains it.
So the arrow keys still control the green player. Then what did the click on the red target do? It rotated/moved the red piece. Hmm, wait — maybe the click on the red target actually "dropped" the red target onto the left side? No, the red piece was already on the left side.
Let me reconsider: before the click, the left side had a horizontal bar: gray 4×4 (28-31, 8-11) + red 4×6 (28-31, 12-17) + dark red 4×4 (28-31, 18-21).
After the click: red 6×4 (24-29, 18-21) + dark red 4×4 (30-33, 18-21) + gray 4×4 (30-33, 8-11).
So the red piece rotated 90° clockwise? A 4×6 horizontal rotated 90° becomes 6×4 vertical. And the position: the red piece is now at rows 24-29, cols 18-21 — above the dark red. The gray and dark red moved down by 2 rows.
Hmm, this looks like the entire bar rotated 90° around some pivot? Let me verify: rotate the bar (rows 28-31, cols 8-21, 4×14) 90° clockwise → 14×4 vertical: rows 28-41, cols... no, the result is a red 6×4 at rows 24-29 + dark red 4×4 at rows 30-33 + gray 4×4 at rows 30-33 cols 8-11. That's not a rotation of the whole bar.
Actually, maybe: the red piece moved to form the "goal silhouette" preview? The red target silhouette is 7×3 on top of 13×2. The red piece is now 6×4 vertical... no.
Wait a sec. Let me re-verify: maybe the click on the red target actually triggered a "level reset" or "new arrangement" — that is, the game re-randomized the left side? Unlikely.
Alternative: the click on the red target "selected" the red piece, and the red piece is now in a "held" state, and its position/rotation is... hmm.
Let me try clicking the red target again and see if the red piece rotates again.

- RIGHT did nothing: green player is clamped at right edge of its block → arrows still control green player only.
- Red piece rotation/move after target click remains unexplained. Probe: click red target again (rotate again?), then click blue target.

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(): return current_frame.ascii
def diff(a,b):
    la, lb = a.split('\n'), b.split('\n')
    return [(i,j,la[i][j],lb[i][j]) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if la[i][j]!=lb[i][j]]
s0=snap()
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])
s1=snap()
d=diff(s0,s1)
print("2nd click red target diff n=",len(d))
print([x for x in d if x[0]!=63][:40])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
